purpose: Hand-curated seed examples per category. Used to bootstrap the persona-script spot-check pipeline (PR_1C_PLAN §1.7.2 step 3) before live scraped questions arrive. The real spot-check sample (30 questions stratified across the six categories) will replace this file's role once it's generated in PR 1.C.A.7.
_note_to_aayan: Use this as the spot-check seed when reviewing classifier category boundaries. Each category has 5-7 examples. The ambiguous_examples section contains questions designed to push the classifier toward the low-confidence-default path (confidence < 0.5 → meta_motivational). If the classifier confidently categorizes ambiguous examples as something other than meta_motivational, the disambiguation hints in categoryPrompts.ts need iteration.
